name: dotswarm
description: Hand planned coding work to a DeepSeek Flash agent team that coordinates through a shared task board, mailbox, and findings ledger while your model supervises.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate planned work to a DeepSeek agent team.
interface.longDescription: DotSwarm lets the model running your Codex session act as a foreman: it plans, hands the work to a team of inexpensive DeepSeek Flash agents running in the DeepSeek Harness, receives compressed state, steers on exceptions, audits the result, and sends a refactor team before a final sweep. Teams coordinate through a shared task board, durable mailbox, and findings ledger, and design work is iterated from real screenshots.
defaultPrompt: Plan this task, then run it with the swarm and review the result.
Check that DotSwarm is set up and ready.
Resume the detached swarm and finish the remaining work.
